[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Amount: 15
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh, Vini Bitencourt, Liz
- Description: 15-minute call with Vini Bitencourt and Liz on sourcing salt from Brazil into the USA via the Agroverse network. Deal parameters discussed: 2,000-5,000 tons of highway/street salting salt, CIF, bound for Ohio USA, destination zip code 40005. Reviewed the counterparty evidence pack that was sent: (1) three Chinese GB/T 5462-2015 inspection reports (Shouguang Dinghao 'coarse-grained sea salt' 35t, Shandong Yanda 'solar salt', Shandong Haihe 'industrial salt'), all reporting NaCl 95.0-95.2% and moisture 3.5-3.7%; (2) a Vetec sodium chloride MSDS marked 'for research and development use only'; (3) the Vini Bitencourt WhatsApp thread. Open items: Jayson's buyer questionnaire (5 questions on NaCl %, rock vs solar, ASTM Type 1 Grade 1 + gradation, moisture + YPS anti-caking, stockpile COA/pictures, pile age and crusting) to be answered. Findings submitted to governor: COAs are Chinese not Brazilian; no sieve/gradation analysis so ASTM D632 Type 1 Grade 1 is unproven; moisture 3.5-3.7% exceeds common US state DOT limits of 2.0%; no anti-caking agent declared; zip code 40005 is not a valid US ZIP (Kentucky 400xx jumps 40004 -> 40006) so a CIF quote cannot be priced; and two of the three COAs are numerically identical on seven parameters despite different companies and sampling dates a month apart.
- Type: Time (Minutes)
--------
